mcat_description.short: A Wooden Guard Room is a small prefabricated portable cabin constructed with a wooden frame and plywood or marine ply walls, sold as a complete ready-to-install unit for use as a security guard post at gates and premises entrances.
mcat_description.long: Wooden Guard Rooms are factory-built, portable security cabins with a wooden or MS pipe structural frame, plywood, marine ply, or blockboard wall panels, corrugated GI or PVC fibre sheet roofing, and plywood or PVC tile flooring. They are supplied as complete units in standard sizes ranging from 4'×4' to 8'×10', with options for sliding aluminium windows, a single door, basic electrical fittings, and thermocol or PUF insulation. These structures are designed for rapid on-site installation, easy relocation, and low maintenance, making them a cost-effective alternative to permanent masonry guard posts. Buyers typically procure them for construction sites, factory gates, residential society entrances, commercial premises, and institutional campuses across India.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, 'Wooden Guard Room' and 'Guard Room Cabin' are the dominant buyer-facing terms for small prefabricated portable security cabins with wooden construction. The category sits within the broader prefabricated portable cabin segment, with wooden construction being a distinct sub-type alongside steel/MS, FRP, and PUF panel variants. Standard commercial sizes are 4'×4', 4'×6', 4'×8', 6'×8', and 8'×10', with 4'×4' and 6'×4' being the most commonly stocked sizes. Wall construction typically uses marine ply, blockboard, or cement fibre board (CFB) panels on an MS pipe or wooden frame; roofing is typically corrugated GI sheet or PVC fibre sheet; flooring uses plywood or PVC tiles on an MS plate base. The NCR region (Delhi, Ghaziabad, Greater Noida, Noida) is the dominant manufacturing and supply hub for this category in India. Buyers are primarily construction contractors, industrial facility managers, residential society committees, and commercial property developers. The category overlaps with 'Portable Security Cabins' (steel/FRP material) and 'Guard Huts' in the broader taxonomy — the wooden variant is distinguished by its material and typically lower cost point. No BIS/IS mandatory standard specifically governs wooden portable guard cabins; quality is determined by plywood grade (BWR/BWP/marine ply), wall panel thickness, and structural frame specification.
